notes.finding: Fragment return address was reset before ABI classification; corrected harness classification.
Original saves only X/Y in the current-position scratch; preserve untouched Z slot.
Table quantization and axis conversion use the independent original conversion control word; new horizontal routine handles all four modes.
Regular path stores Y into frame+0x30; remaining path uses frame+0x28. These offsets belong to distinct live temporaries.
Transform receives frame+0xAC after the first argument push, not frame+0xA8.
Test drive must be a byte buffer; uint32 array pointer arithmetic placed owner at the wrong byte offset. Harness corrected and all phases rerun.
